title: 01-login-desktop-en
prompt: Design the LOGIN screen, desktop 1440px wide. IMPORTANT: this is an UNAUTHENTICATED screen, so it has NO app shell — no left icon rail and no top bar. Build a full-bleed two-panel layout instead. LEFT PANEL, about 45 percent width, on the #F8F8F7 app-frame background, holding the sign-in card centered vertically with generous padding. At the top of the panel, the brand lockup: a 44px deep-red #B4232A logo mark above 'Rosalia's Kitchen' in 22px/600 #1F2937 and 'Staff Hub' in 15px #6B7280. THE SIGN-IN CARD: white, 1px #E5E7EB border, 16px radius, 32px padding, about 400px wide. Heading 'Sign in' 24/600 with a 14px #6B7280 sub-line 'Welcome back. Use the method your manager set up for you.' THE METHOD STACK, in priority order: 1) A full-width 48px GOOGLE BUTTON — white with a 1px #E5E7EB border, a Google 'G' mark at the left and 'Continue with Google' in 15px/500 #1F2937, centered. 2) A divider row with a 1px #E5E7EB rule either side of the word 'or' in 12px #6B7280. 3) An EMAIL FIELD with a 13px/500 #6B7280 label 'Email' above a 44px input containing 'allison.rodriguez@example.com'. 4) A PASSWORD FIELD labeled 'Password' above a 44px input showing masked bullets with a trailing eye icon to reveal, and a ghost 'Forgot password?' link in 13px #2563EB right-aligned beneath it. 5) A 'Remember me on this device' checkbox row, checked, in 14px. 6) A full-width 48px primary #2563EB button 'Sign in'. 7) A THIRD METHOD shown as unavailable: a full-width 48px button rendered at 40 percent opacity with a 1px border, a phone icon and 'Continue with a texted code', carrying a small gray 'Coming soon' chip at its right — it must read clearly as disabled, not merely secondary. Beneath the card a 13px #6B7280 line 'Don't have an account? Ask your manager for an invite.' and, at the bottom of the panel, an EN/ES segmented language toggle with EN active plus a 12px #6B7280 legal line with 'Privacy' and 'Terms' links. RIGHT PANEL, about 55 percent width, a calm brand surface: a solid very light warm background with a subtle deep-red #B4232A accent used sparingly — for example a thin left edge rule and a small repeated line-art pattern at very low opacity. Centered in it, a restrained marketing block: a 28px/600 #1F2937 line 'Everything your shift needs, in one place.' with a 16px #6B7280 sub-line 'Schedules, punches, tips, trades and tasks.' beneath, and under that a simple flat line-art illustration in thin 1.5px strokes suggesting a schedule grid and a phone. Keep this panel quiet and typographic — it must not look like a marketing landing page. Design every label to tolerate about 30 percent text expansion for Spanish. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, #2563EB for the primary sign-in action. The deep-red #B4232A appears only in the logo mark and the subtle right-panel accent, never as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.

title: 02-invite-acceptance-desktop-en
prompt: Design the INVITE ACCEPTANCE FLOW, desktop 1440px wide, showing all THREE steps side by side on a single frame so the whole sequence reads at once. IMPORTANT: these are UNAUTHENTICATED screens with NO app shell — no left icon rail and no top bar. Use the #F8F8F7 app-frame background across the whole frame, and above each of the three panels place a small 12px/600 uppercase letter-spaced #6B7280 caption reading 'STEP 1 — INVITATION', 'STEP 2 — CHOOSE SIGN-IN METHOD' and 'STEP 3 — SUCCESS'. Each panel is a white bordered rounded-xl card about 400px wide with 32px padding, vertically centered, and each carries the brand lockup at its top: a 36px deep-red #B4232A logo mark above 'Rosalia's Kitchen' in 18px/600 and 'Staff Hub' in 13px #6B7280. PANEL 1 — INVITATION: a 48px teal-tinted circular badge with a #14B8A6 envelope icon. Heading 'You've been invited to Rosalia's Kitchen Staff Hub' at 22px/600 #1F2937 across two lines. A 14px #6B7280 paragraph 'Denise Lasarte invited you to join the team. Set up your account to see your schedule, clock in and report tips.' Then an INVITE DETAIL CARD: a bordered rounded-lg inner panel with three label-value rows separated by 1px borders — 'Name' with 'Karla Ceballos', 'Role' with an amber 'Server · L1' chip, 'Email' with 'karla.ceballos@example.com'. Beneath it a full-width 48px primary #2563EB button 'Accept invitation' and a ghost 'This isn't me' link in 13px #6B7280. At the panel's foot a 12px #6B7280 line 'This invitation expires in 7 days.' PANEL 2 — CHOOSE SIGN-IN METHOD: heading 'How do you want to sign in?' 22px/600 with a 14px #6B7280 sub-line 'You can add another method later from your profile.' Then the method stack: a full-width 48px white bordered Google button with the 'G' mark and 'Continue with Google'; a divider row with 'or' in 12px #6B7280; an 'Email' input pre-filled and shown READ-ONLY with a small lock icon and a light #F8F8F7 fill containing 'karla.ceballos@example.com', with a 12px #6B7280 helper 'This is the address your invitation was sent to.'; a 'Create a password' input showing masked bullets with an eye icon; a 'Confirm password' input showing masked bullets; a PASSWORD STRENGTH row with a three-segment bar where two segments are filled teal and a 12px label 'Good' plus a 12px #6B7280 hint 'At least 8 characters with one number.'; then a full-width 48px primary #2563EB button 'Create account'; and beneath it the disabled third method — a full-width 48px button at 40 percent opacity with a phone icon, 'Continue with a texted code' and a gray 'Coming soon' chip. PANEL 3 — SUCCESS: a 64px teal-tinted #E6F7F5 circular badge with a 32px #14B8A6 check mark in a rounded 4px stroke. Heading 'You're all set, Karla' 22px/600 centered with a 14px #6B7280 sub-line 'Your account is ready. Here's what to do first.' Then a NEXT-STEPS list: three rows, each with a small numbered circle, a 14px/600 title and a 12px #6B7280 detail — '1. Set your availability' with 'Due Thursday at 11:59 PM'; '2. Sign the Employee Handbook' with '2 documents need your signature'; '3. Add a profile photo' with 'Helps managers recognize you on the schedule'. Beneath, a full-width 48px primary #2563EB button 'Go to my dashboard' and a ghost 'Set availability first' link in 13px #2563EB. At the foot of each panel place an EN/ES segmented language toggle with EN active. Design every label to tolerate about 30 percent text expansion for Spanish. Use ONLY the design system's fonts, colors, spacing and components; keep Inter, #2563EB for primary actions, teal #14B8A6 for the invitation and success states. The deep-red #B4232A appears only in the logo marks, never as a button color. No gradients, no serif or decorative typefaces.
